name: android_set_network
description: Changes connectivity: normal, offline, wifi_only, data_only, wifi_on, wifi_off, airplane_on, airplane_off. offline, data_only, wifi_off, and airplane_on cut Wi-Fi and drop a Wi-Fi ADB connection, with no remote way back: use them over USB, or confirm first.

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.
